command:
set +e
echo "=== build ==="; cargo build --locked >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "BUILD_EXIT=$?"
echo "=== fmt --check ==="; cargo fmt --all --check >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "FMT_EXIT=$?"
echo "=== clippy -D warnings ==="; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "CLIPPY_EXIT=$?"
echo "=== nextest ==="; cargo nextest run --locked 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "NEXTEST_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
